name: duplicate block
reason: another block is already named
nextAction: give each block a distinct heading

name: action ID collision
reason: distinct block titles produce the same action ID
nextAction: rename one block so its action ID is distinct

name: empty block
reason: this block has no steps
nextAction: add a numbered step or a ✓ check to the block

name: late precondition
reason: starts on must come before the block's steps
nextAction: move starts on: before the first step in the block

name: unnumbered step
reason: not a numbered step or a ✓ line
nextAction: prefix the step with a number such as 1. or use ✓ for a check

name: missing input name
reason: fill needs a target and a valid input name
nextAction: use Fill "field" with input NAME, where NAME matches [A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,31}

name: invalid annotation
reason: invalid runtime input declaration
nextAction: remove the invalid annotation; declare runtime inputs with Fill "field" with input NAME, optionally followed by (test-pii) or (secret)

name: missing quoted fill
reason: fill needs the text in quotes
nextAction: put the fill text in quotes: Type "text" into "field"

name: missing target after text
reason: fill needs a target after the quoted text
nextAction: add the target after the text: Type "text" into "field"

name: invalid echo
reason: expect input needs a declared input name and "on screen"
nextAction: use Expect input NAME on screen with a name declared by a fill step

name: undeclared echo
reason: expect input names an input no fill step in this plan uses
nextAction: add a Fill "field" with input NAME step for this input, or use an already declared name

name: conflicting declarations
plan:
1. Fill "field" with input CODE
2. Fill "other" with input CODE (non-secret)
reason: conflicting runtime input declarations
nextAction: use the same sensitivity annotation for every fill of this input

name: conditional dialog
reason: dialog needs one explicit accept or dismiss action without conditions or negation
nextAction: use Accept the dialog or Dismiss the dialog without conditions or negation

name: empty plan
reason: the plan has no steps
nextAction: add a numbered step such as 1. Tap "target"

name: unsupported verb
reason: the line is unsupported or the verb judgment is unsure
nextAction: rewrite as one supported operation: Tap, Type, Scroll, Wait, Go back, Accept or Dismiss the dialog

name: fallback fill
reason: fill fallback needs Verb "text" into/in target or target with text/value "text"; use Type "text" into target otherwise
nextAction: use Type "text" into "field"

name: fallback fill beside a typed value that occurs in the reason
plan:
1. Type "text" into "Notes"
2. Provide hello as a greeting
reason: fill fallback needs Verb "text" into/in target or target with text/value "text"; use Type "text" into target otherwise
nextAction: use Type "text" into "field"

name: action ID collision beside a typed value that occurs in the reason
reason: distinct block titles produce the same action ID
nextAction: rename one block so its action ID is distinct

name: fallback scroll
reason: scroll fallback needs an explicit until target or a bare direction
nextAction: use Scroll down, Scroll up, or Scroll down until "target"

name: annotation on heading
reason: invalid runtime input declaration
nextAction: remove the invalid annotation; declare runtime inputs with Fill "field" with input NAME, optionally followed by (test-pii) or (secret)
